{{Quote|My mortification is most acute. As gatemaster, defense of the hypergate is my first function. But I am Administrator caste&mdash;wholly unsuited to this task!|Gatemaster Beltek'k, recruiting help with the situation on Asation|<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Ancient Allies|the ''Gav Daragon''}}</ref>}}
'''Beltek'k''' was a [[Gatemaster]] of the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During that time, the planet [[Asation]] had been attacked by [[Kephess]] who served the [[Dread Masters]] as they attempted to sow fear in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. As a result, the mutated [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] took control of the [[Grand Hypergate]] and created a rift in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] that brought the emergence of numerous hostile lifeforms. Thus, in desperation, the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] dispatched Gatemaster Beltek'k who held a duty to defend the [[Hypergate]]. This saw him journey to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to enlist the aid of numerous spacers to undo the damage done to Asation before it became permanent. Following the completion of this task, the Gatemaster along with other Gree dignitaries decided to honor the spacers by awarding them the title of Red Rhombus.
